title: Close the SearchCombobox popup when the input loses focus
body:
## Summary
A typed query keeps the SearchCombobox listbox open after the input blurs, so the popup floats over the page and aria-expanded stays true.

## Description
`open` is `needle.length > 0` (src/components/layout-lab/ui/SearchCombobox.tsx:127); onBlur only clears `recallOpen` (src/components/layout-lab/ui/SearchCombobox.tsx:201). On the inline /status EntitySearch, typing then Tab/click-away leaves the absolutely positioned popup (POPUP_SHELL, zIndex 10) covering content. APG combobox: the popup collapses when focus leaves. Fix: track focus and gate the popup on it (options already preventDefault on mousedown, so picking stays safe).

## Flow
- type 'dr' in the /status entity search -> popup opens
- press Tab -> focus leaves; popup and aria-expanded=true remain
- fix: a `focused` state gates the popup; re-focus re-opens it with the query intact

## Expected impact
Keyboard and mouse users on /status stop seeing a stale popup over the page. Could break: ~19 consumer test files drive the combobox with fireEvent.change and never focus it, so they must focus first.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - no stale popup after focus leaves
Before: popup render depends only on the query (SearchCombobox.tsx:127), not on focus
After: test: change + blur -> no listbox; focus -> listbox back; every LabSearch/EntitySearch test still green
Method: simulation - three walked cases (Tab-away, click-away, Modal close); the consumer-test churn to add focus() is why it was not built in-round
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: vitest: fireEvent.change then fireEvent.blur on the input -> queryByRole('listbox') null; run the LabSearch*/EntitySearch* suites for churn

title: Use the lab elevation token for the SearchCombobox popup shadow
body:
## Summary
The combobox popup hand-rolls `0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)` instead of the theme's `--lab-elev-*` token.

## Description
POPUP_SHELL (src/components/layout-lab/ui/SearchCombobox.tsx:94) hardcodes a shadow. lab-tokens.css declares `--lab-elev-1..3: none` for Blueprint (flat, by design) and graded shadows for Studio; Panel (src/components/layout-lab/ui/Panel.tsx:20) is the pair that reads the token. So in Blueprint the popup is the only floating lab surface with a drop shadow. Fix: `boxShadow: 'var(--lab-elev-2)'` (Studio's value is within a hair of today's).

## Flow
- open the lab in Blueprint, open search, type
- popup casts a soft black shadow; every other lab surface is flat
- fix: read --lab-elev-2

## Expected impact
Blueprint keeps its flat-drafting look on the one surface that breaks it. Could break: popup separation in Blueprint would rely on its 1px border alone.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one theming contract for elevation
Before: 1 hardcoded shadow in the lab ui primitives; Panel reads the token
After: 0 hardcoded; screenshot pair in both themes
Method: simulation - token values compared by reading lab-tokens.css; the visual verdict needs a screenshot pair
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: screenshot pair of the popup in Blueprint and Studio before/after, plus a test asserting POPUP_SHELL.boxShadow reads var(--lab-elev-

title: Raise --lab-muted to the AA text floor in the Blueprint theme
body:
## Summary
The --lab-muted token measures 3.70:1 on the Blueprint floor and is used as a text colour at ~30 lab sites.

## Description
lab-tokens.css sets Blueprint `--lab-muted: #647488` on `--lab-bg: #dde3ec` = 3.70:1 (4.32:1 on the composited panel), under WCAG 1.4.3 for 14px text. This round moved the two primitive captions (Stat, Field) to `--text-subtle` (5.16:1), but `grep -rn lab-muted src/components/layout-lab --include=*.tsx` still counts 30 uses. The token file belongs to lab-shell-and-navigation, so the token itself is out of scope here. Fix: darken Blueprint --lab-muted (e.g. to the --text-subtle value) so every consumer clears the floor at once.

## Flow
- src/__tests__/components/layout-lab/ui/labLabelLegibility.test.tsx measures it: worstContrast('--lab-muted') = 3.70
- change the Blueprint value
- re-run: that test's seeded-control case flips and must seed a literal sub-floor colour instead

## Expected impact
Every muted caption in the light lab theme becomes readable at AA. Could break: visual snapshots that pin the old grey.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - legibility floor across the lab
Before: --lab-muted 3.70:1 (blueprint, bg) / 4.32:1 (panel); 30 tsx uses
After: >= 4.5:1 on both surfaces, same 30 uses
Method: probe - contrast computed with src/lib/contrast.ts over the real token file in the new test; not built because the token file is a sibling context's
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: labLabelLegibility.test.tsx worstContrast('--lab-muted') >= 4.5 after the token change (swap its seeded control to a literal sub-floor colour)

title: Expose single-select lab view buttons as one selection, not N toggles
body:
## Summary
Single-select groups (lab view switch, Studio render mode) are built from Button `active`, which announces each option as an independent pressed toggle.

## Description
LayoutLab's view switch (src/components/layout-lab/LayoutLab.tsx:130) and StudioToolbar's render mode (src/components/studio-3d/StudioToolbar.tsx:57) pass `active={x === value}` to Button, which maps to aria-pressed. A screen reader hears independent toggles, all but one 'not pressed', with no sign they are exclusive. A segmented pattern (aria-current, or role=radiogroup) states it. Grid/Axes/Rotate (src/components/studio-3d/StudioToolbar.tsx:62) are real toggles and are correct. Fix: a `current` mode on Button and migrate the two groups.

## Flow
- open /layout with a screen reader on the view switch -> 'Catalogs, toggle button, pressed', 'Matrix, toggle button, not pressed' ...
- fix: Button `current` prop -> aria-current; the two consumers switch from active to current

## Expected impact
Screen-reader users understand the view switch is pick-one. Could break: viewTransition.test.tsx and studio tests pin aria-pressed on these buttons.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - correct semantics for single-select groups
Before: 2 single-select groups announced as independent toggles
After: 2 groups announced as a selection
Method: simulation - walked both groups by reading the consumers, which are lab-shell-and-navigation / studio-3d files
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: vitest: the lab view switch exposes aria-current (or radio) semantics; viewTransition + studio suites updated in the same change

title: Remove the lab ui atoms nothing imports (Chip, VisuallyHidden, Field label, barrel)
body:
## Summary
Four exports of the lab atom library have zero production importers; only their own unit tests reach them.

## Description
Zero-consumer greps over src/ excluding __tests__: `ui/Chip'` 0; `ui/VisuallyHidden'` 0 (its doc claims the skip-to-canvas link; SearchCombobox uses the `.sr-only` class instead - two implementations of one rule); the `Field` label component 0 (src/components/layout-lab/steps/controls.tsx:4 imports only Input/Textarea); the barrel src/components/layout-lab/ui/index.ts 0 importers (every consumer imports a file path). Chip also conveys ok/warn/bad by hue alone (WCAG 1.4.1), so keeping it means fixing it. Removal edits the context-map description (director-owned) and deletes tested atoms - an owner call.

## Flow
- grep -rlE "ui/Chip'" src -> only Chip.test.tsx
- barrel import grep -> nothing
- decide: delete (with their tests and the context-map rows) or keep and fix Chip's hue-only tone

## Expected impact
The atom surface shrinks by 4 exports with zero behaviour change. Could break: an untracked WIP file importing them (none found).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - smaller atom surface
Before: 4 exports, 0 production importers, 2 test files exercising them
After: 0 dead exports, or Chip fixed to glyph+word if kept
Method: probe - zero-consumer grep run this round
Result: better
Gate: architecture
evidence:
grep -rlE "ui/Chip'" src => src/__tests__/components/layout-lab/ui/Chip.test.tsx
grep -rlE "ui/VisuallyHidden'" src => src/__tests__/components/layout-lab/ui/Stat.test.tsx
barrel importers: 0
src/components/layout-lab/steps/controls.tsx:4 imports { Input, Textarea } only

title: Let SearchCombobox Home/End move the caret in the input
body:
## Summary
SearchCombobox takes Home/End for first/last option whenever hits are shown, so a user cannot move the caret within the query.

## Description
onKeyDown in src/components/layout-lab/ui/SearchCombobox.tsx preventDefaults Home/End while hits exist. Focus stays in the editable input (aria-activedescendant), and the APG editable-combobox pattern keeps standard text-editing keys for the textbox; Home/End on options is optional there. Fix: drop the Home/End branches (or require a modifier), keep the arrows.

## Flow
- type 'dragon blade', press Home to edit the start -> the highlight jumps to option 0, the caret does not move
- fix: Home/End fall through to the input

## Expected impact
Editing a long query from the keyboard works as in every text field. Could break: anyone relying on Home/End to jump options (no test pins it).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - standard text editing in the search input
Before: Home/End -> option jump, caret frozen (read from code)
After: Home/End -> caret moves; arrows still browse
Method: simulation - APG pattern read against the handler; whether option-jump is wanted is a product call
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: vitest: keyDown Home with hits -> event not defaultPrevented and active option unchanged; owner A/B on keyboard feel

title: Give the icon-only IconButton a visible hover hint from its aria-label
body:
## Summary
IconButton names itself only through aria-label, so a sighted mouse user hovering the lab theme toggle gets no hint of what it does.

## Description
IconButton (src/components/layout-lab/ui/IconButton.tsx:3) accepts no `title` and spreads no rest props; its one consumer, ThemeToggle (src/components/layout-lab/LayoutLab.tsx:213), shows only a Sun/Moon glyph whose meaning is inverted (it shows the theme you switch TO). Fix: `title={ariaLabel}` (or the shared ui/Tooltip), pinned by a test.

## Flow
- hover the lab's sun/moon icon -> nothing appears
- fix: a hover hint mirrors ariaLabel

## Expected impact
Sighted users learn the icon's action on hover. Could break: nothing pins the absence.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - discoverable icon-only action
Before: 1 icon-only lab button, 0 visible hints
After: 1/1 with a hover hint
Method: simulation - one consumer walked; native title vs ui/Tooltip is a design choice
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: vitest: getByRole('button',{name}).getAttribute('title') equals ariaLabel; design check native title vs ui/Tooltip
